info: CARD-0338/CARD-0383: probes data-pipeline-api's /health every 5 minutes and alerts (log + Pixel push) on two consecutive failures or responses slower than 10 s (one bad check is tolerated), re-alerts every 30 min while bad, and reports recovery. Independent of the Environmental Data tab's write queue. Renamed from 'Sheet Health' (CARD-0383) -- it stopped probing Google Sheets back in CARD-0349 but kept the old name, which read as stale cruft rather than a real, load-bearing check.
